draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: On the unseen test sets of the Banking and Travel domains, Wrenfold achieves higher macro-F1 than Fennick-Base (93.1 vs 91.6 on Banking; 92.4 vs 90.9 on Travel).
rationale: The evidence only covers the unseen test sets of the two trained domains (Banking, Travel). No evaluation on domains not seen in training is reported, so the generalization claim is unsupported; the supported claim is the observed advantage on the unseen test sets.
